_provenance: Move 80 Phase 1 contract inventory against the adopted Move 79 v27 baseline (zip sha256 4a95767a3f68ca812c1d543894b65183b82d56f3f8f56e9af61b82c19de1f26b), decisions ratified by independent hostile review. Expectations are DECLARED from that inventory; they are never regenerated from whatever current code emits.

_evidence_tiers.OBSERVED: directly executed against the v27 baseline during the Phase 1 inventory (frozen Python verifier / Python ZipGuard oracle)
_evidence_tiers.SOURCE_VERIFIED: established from the exact v27 source and its tests
_evidence_tiers.TERMUX_CONFIRMED: supported by the preserved real v27 Termux adoption evidence (85-case agreement run and/or the 124 cargo unit tests executed inside RUST_WORKSPACE_CHECK)
_evidence_tiers.REQUIRES_NEW_TERMUX_CONFIRMATION: cannot be honestly executed off-device; the Move 80 Termux adoption run is the confirming evidence

_meaning_of_case_pass: A case PASSES when every DECLARED per-lane expectation below is met exactly. MOVE_80_REQUIRED_CASES: 8/8 PASS therefore means the verifiers produced the declared expected outcomes for all eight fixtures. It NEVER means the corrupted bundles verified successfully: for seven of the eight fixtures the expected outcome on at least one lane is FAIL, and the Rust verifier cannot emit PASS at all (adopted honesty property; exit 0 unreachable).
_stderr_contract: Every verifier/oracle invocation must produce zero stderr bytes; any stderr output fails the case.

rust_expected.note: the adopted Rust verifier can NEVER emit PASS; INCONCLUSIVE/3 is its honest clean-bundle ceiling and must not be described as PASS

M80-MISSING-MANIFEST-001.class_split_note: the lanes reject at the same stage but under different adopted reason classes (Python REQUIRED_FILE_MISSING vs Rust MANIFEST_MISSING); this split is recorded honestly and the case is NOT added to the frozen 85-case agreement corpus

rust_expected.evidence_note: cargo unit test missing_manifest_fails ran on Termux in the v27 gate; this exact fixture bundle still requires the Move 80 Termux run

M80-CHANGED-EVIDENCE-001.capability_limit_note: the adopted Rust verifier checks only the eight declared top-level/coordinator hashes and does not recurse into nested component checksums; evidence-byte tampering is invisible to it by adopted design. This is a documented capability limit; Move 80 does not modify Rust to inspect nested evidence.

rust_expected.evidence_note: the frozen corpus declared Rust out of scope for evidence_byte_flip and never executed it; this blindness assertion is first executed on-device by the Move 80 gate

M80-UNKNOWN-SCHEMA-001.capability_limit_note: the frozen Python verifier never checks companion_cli_version (OBSERVED: PASS/0 on this canonically re-serialized, checksum-repaired mutation during the inventory); documented Python blindness to this field.
